name: Bigfoot – Camera Shy
title: Bigfoot – Camera Shy Mug
story: This bigfoot mug is for the hiker, camper or cryptid fan who knows why every sighting is a blurry photo: Bigfoot covers his face with one hand as he walks through the pines, and it makes an easy Christmas morning coffee gift or stocking stuffer for anyone who loves the woods.

The print is a shaggy sasquatch in forest green, rust and cream fur, one big hand over his face, walking between two tall pines and a bed of ferns, with CAMERA SHY in dark green slab capitals underneath. It reads from across the room, on bright white glossy ceramic.

It matches our Camera Shy hoodie, so the mug and the hoodie make a set for the same outdoorsy person. Fill it with coffee, tea or cocoa and let Bigfoot explain, with one hand, why nobody has ever gotten a clear picture of him.
joke_a: Bigfoot has never been photographed clearly because he is camera shy, and he is walking away with a hand over his face to prove it. The Camera Shy bigfoot mug from Graphic Tees Co. gives hikers, campers and cryptid fans the joke with every sip of coffee.
